home.title: Inovance Robot Assistant
home.description: A collection of tools for designing, programming, and commissioning INOVANCE robots.

robotSelect.title: INOVANCE Robot Model Selection
robotSelect.description: Select an INOVANCE robot and options, then download CAD files and a configuration sheet.

robot3dViewer.title: INOVANCE Robot 3D Viewer
robot3dViewer.description: View INOVANCE robot 3D models and download related CAD files.

toolSelector.title: Robot Tool Load Selection
toolSelector.description: Calculate tool mass, center of gravity, and inertia to verify robot suitability.

projectGenerator.title: INOVANCE Robot Project Generator
projectGenerator.description: Generate an INOVANCE robot project from the selected process and options.

software.title: INOVANCE Robot Software Center
software.description: Check and download the latest INOVANCE robot software.

manual.title: INOVANCE Robot Technical Document Center
manual.description: Search robot manuals, training materials, certificates, and communication profiles.

debugging.title: Debugging Tool | InoRobot Assistant
debugging.description: Tools for robot diagnostics, communication testing, data comparison, and zero calibration.

zeroCalibration.title: Robot Zero Calibration Tool
zeroCalibration.description: Calculate robot zero calibration values from factory and current encoder values.
